name: Cumulonimbus - Still the Clouds of My Childhood Remain
source:
“I saw her. She had always been beautiful, but today she’s especially pretty under the scarlet sky. I want to hold her, to tell her I loved her, that I didn’t want to see her cry, that I didn’t want to let her go, to say I’m sorry for… I saw her. Underneath the scarlet sky.”

[From [url=https://nouzivr.itch.io/cumulonimbus]itch.io[/url]]
